Poly Haven texture assets
=========================

Source:  https://polyhaven.com
License: CC0 1.0 Universal (Creative Commons Zero) - public domain dedication
         https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Poly Haven states: "You do not need to give credit or attribution when using
them (although it is appreciated)."

Attribution is therefore NOT required. Credit is given voluntarily in
Assets/VRMaintenanceResearch/ThirdParty/THIRD_PARTY_ASSETS.md.

Assets used in this project
---------------------------
1. Concrete Floor Worn 001  (concrete_floor_worn_001)
   https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_floor_worn_001
   Authors: Dimitrios Savva (photography), Rico Cilliers (processing)

2. Beige Wall 001  (beige_wall_001)
   https://polyhaven.com/a/beige_wall_001
   Authors: Dimitrios Savva (photography), Rico Cilliers (processing)

Only the 1k JPG variants (diffuse, OpenGL normal, roughness) were downloaded.
